scope: Offline execution of unchanged worker/provider source through explicit local adapters; no AWS calls or publication

fixedScenarios.messages: one delivery of one synthetic order
same message delivered at receiveCount 1 and 2
two different message IDs for the same business order and run, each receiveCount 1
one real handler delivery; local observer deliberately withholds ledger snapshot

fixedScenarios.effectModel: external effect with no atomic idempotency contract
fixedScenarios.messages: unsupported model must be rejected without inventing an external effect

tuningPolicy: The different-message-ids variation and expected outcomes are fixed before implementation. Do not change them to make the candidate pass.
sensitivityChecks: In a temporary clean copy remove only the repaired worker's stable idempotency key; crash and different-message-ids repaired cases must become non-passes
In a separate temporary clean copy replace worker.handler with an immediate exception; no-fault control must become a non-pass
validation: One documented python3 -I -S command in a clean git archive/export extraction with credentials removed and a no-network guard. Record fingerprints, individual outcomes and exit codes. Preserve historical AWS bytes and archives unchanged.
publication: All Git and deliverables local. No pushes, new remotes, publications, uploads or AWS API calls.
